text: Your 401K’s will go to hell and it’ll be a very, very sad day for this country.

speaker: WELKER
text: Alright.

speaker: WELKER
text: Vice President Biden, same question to you.

speaker: WELKER
text: What will you say during your inaugural address to Americans who did not vote for you?

speaker: BIDEN
text: I will say, I’m an American president.

speaker: BIDEN
text: I represent all of you whether you voted for me or against me.

speaker: BIDEN
text: And I’m going to make sure that you’re represented.

speaker: BIDEN
text: I’m going to give you hope.

speaker: BIDEN
text: We’re going to move.

speaker: BIDEN
text: We’re going to choose science over fiction.

speaker: BIDEN
text: We’re going to choose hope over fear.

speaker: BIDEN
text: We’re going to choose to move forward because we have enormous opportunities, enormous opportunities to make things better.

speaker: BIDEN
text: We can grow this economy.

speaker: BIDEN
text: We can deal with systemic racism.

speaker: BIDEN
text: At the same time, we can make sure that our economy is being run, and moved, and motivated by clean energy, creating millions of new jobs.

speaker: BIDEN
text: And that’s the fact, that’s what we’re going to do.

speaker: BIDEN
text: And I’m going to say, as I said at the beginning, what is on the ballot here is the character of this country.

speaker: BIDEN
text: Decency.

speaker: BIDEN
text: Honor.

speaker: BIDEN
text: Respect.

speaker: BIDEN
text: Treating people with dignity.

speaker: BIDEN
text: Making sure that everyone has an even chance.

speaker: BIDEN
text: Now, I’m going to make sure you get that.

speaker: BIDEN
text: You haven’t been getting it the last four years.

speaker: WELKER
text: Alright.

speaker: WELKER
text: I want to thank you both for a very robust hour and a half, a fantastic debate.

speaker: WELKER
text: Really appreciate it.

speaker: WELKER

speaker: WELKER
text: Thank you to Belmont University for hosting us tonight and most importantly, thank you to those watching tonight.

text: Election Day is November 3rd.

speaker: WELKER
